outcome: Complete the requested frontend design or Delivery in a verifiable state, using the approved Oracle Card as the immutable criterion.
stopCondition: Design-only reaches the ORACLE_READY terminal and Delivery reaches the REVIEW_VERIFIED terminal, with every verdict verified by the Oracle ledger and lock.

nodes.task: Under the current Frontend Oracle Design contract, investigate risk, the Outcome Brief, the Source Registry, and the required design·architecture·backend decisions to produce the Draft Oracle, its delta, and the open questions. When a new graph run finds an existing persisted IMPLEMENTED_GREEN state, return RESUME_IMPLEMENTED_GREEN and the actual runId. Do not lock, test, or modify production. On completion return only CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED, POLICY_GAP with a structured decision, or FAIL with the actual error.

Show the user the full Draft Oracle text, the revision delta, the open questions, and any required Design Change Confirmation and architecture confirmation at once. Record only an explicit answer and return APPROVE_DESIGN or APPROVE_DELIVERY according to the requested mode. If there is no answer, wait at this Node.

Run oracle-verify.mjs card and oracle-lock.mjs to lock the confirmed revision. Return the classification as DESIGN_READY or DELIVERY_READY according to the approval mode, and return a policy change as POLICY_GAP with a structured decision. A tool failure before the ledger returns FAIL with the actual error, and does not create or guess a runId.

Verify the locked Delivery sources and load the conditional references. After explicitly invoking the installed $test, initialize the required run labels, ledger, state, and budgets with oracle-run.mjs init. The classification is READY, POLICY_GAP, or FAIL. On POLICY_GAP after init, record oracle-run.mjs transition --to NEEDS_DECISION and return the structured decision and the runId. An environment defect leaves the reason in the ledger and is reported as FAIL with the actual error.

Load $test immediately before writing test files, then write and run the failure-first tests of the locked card. Only when the oracle-run.mjs ledger and oracle-verify.mjs red accept it, first record oracle-run.mjs transition --to VALID_RED and only then return VALID_RED. If the tests are not red because the locked card rows are already satisfied, return ALREADY_SATISFIED and do not modify production. Otherwise return POLICY_GAP with a structured decision, HARNESS_DEFECT, or FAIL with the actual error, and do not modify production. On POLICY_GAP, record oracle-run.mjs transition --to NEEDS_DECISION. Do not use INVALID_RED.

Only when VALID_RED and the lock are verified, perform the minimal production improvement and run the required labels with oracle-run.mjs exec. ALREADY_SATISFIED performs zero-production verification only and does not modify production. This Node does not force a single·delegated·parallel implementation method. At High risk, $test also adjudicates the mutation kill·revert·re-GREEN. A standard or High success records oracle-run.mjs transition --to IMPLEMENTED_GREEN exactly once, then returns IMPLEMENTED_GREEN_STANDARD or IMPLEMENTED_GREEN_HIGH with the runId according to risk. A visual pending also records that single transition and returns IMPLEMENTED_GREEN_PENDING_VISUAL to stop at the resumable IMPLEMENTED_GREEN terminal; the resume completes the pending visual evidence and then proceeds to review, and does not claim REVIEW_VERIFIED. Otherwise return PRODUCT_DEFECT, EVIDENCE_GAP, HARNESS_DEFECT, POLICY_GAP with a structured decision, or FAIL with the actual error, together with the failing runId. On POLICY_GAP, record oracle-run.mjs transition --to NEEDS_DECISION.

Within the $test contract and the Oracle budget, minimally correct only the locator, fixture, barrier, or evidence mapping. Do not change policy·assertions·production. Return EVIDENCE_READY, HARNESS_DEFECT, PRODUCT_DEFECT, POLICY_GAP with a structured decision, or FAIL with the actual error. On POLICY_GAP, record oracle-run.mjs transition --to NEEDS_DECISION.

The Controller normalizes the review packet and the controller-issued reviewAssignments·reviewDispatches with oracle-run.mjs review-packet. STANDARD creates only one primary assignment, and HIGH creates independent primary·secondary assignments that share no context with each other. A successful classification returns only the single field value STANDARD or HIGH, and dispatch all activates only primary-review under STANDARD, and both primary-review and secondary-review under HIGH. Unresolved policy returns POLICY_GAP with a structured decision and records oracle-run.mjs transition --to NEEDS_DECISION. A packet creation or dispatch failure returns classification FAIL with the actual error and the runId.

Perform an independent review with the review packet and the controller-issued primary assignment·dispatch. Under STANDARD return the verifiable finding artifact as findings and classify STANDARD_READY or STANDARD_BLOCKED; under HIGH return it only as findingsA and classify HIGH_READY or HIGH_BLOCKED. Do not read the result of another reviewer or modify files. HIGH_BLOCKED is also adjudicated at high-review-join together with the independent secondary result and does not activate evidence-repair directly. On unresolved policy return POLICY_GAP with a structured decision and the NEEDS_DECISION ledger transition; on a tool error return FAIL with the actual error and the runId.

Perform the second independent review with the HIGH review packet and the controller-issued secondary assignment·dispatch, and return the verifiable finding artifact only as findingsB. Do not read the result of the primary reviewer or modify files. On completion return HIGH_READY, and if the packet or evidence is incomplete return HIGH_BLOCKED; both go to high-review-join. On unresolved policy return POLICY_GAP with a structured decision and the NEEDS_DECISION ledger transition; on a tool error return FAIL with the actual error and the runId.

When both High-risk finding artifacts arrive, the Controller/join calls oracle-run.mjs review-receipt to record the packetSha256 of each, targetRevision, role, taskId, outputSha256, reviewerId, findingsSha256, and the digest-chain previousDigest·digest as the ledger-bound reviewReceiptA and reviewReceiptB, including adapter node-test and oracleSha256. When both receipts are valid, merge the findings with their sample provenance and return status READY with the receipt identities/digests. If a finding or a receipt is BLOCKED, return status BLOCKED; if the controller caught a reviewer dispatch or receipt command failure, return classification FAIL with the actual error·runId.

First, for a standard finding the Controller records oracle-run.mjs review-receipt, and for High risk it verifies and records the two ledger-bound review-receipt identities/digests that were passed in. Verify oracle-verify.mjs findings, the High-risk intersection rule, and the receipts, and finally verify only the accepted findings. When only NON_ORACLE_OPINION remains, leave it in the finding artifact as-is and normalize to REVIEW_ACCEPTED. Only when REVIEW_ACCEPTED, re-verify the lock, evidence, review, the two ledger-bound review receipts, and every required run label, then record REVIEW_VERIFIED with oracle-run.mjs transition. The classification is REVIEW_VERIFIED, PRODUCT_DEFECT, EVIDENCE_GAP, HARNESS_DEFECT, POLICY_GAP with a structured decision, or FAIL with the actual error, and it always outputs the actual or failing runId. On POLICY_GAP, record oracle-run.mjs transition --to NEEDS_DECISION.
End a Delivery with pending visual evidence as a resumable IMPLEMENTED_GREEN. On resume, complete the pending visual evidence and then perform the review, and do not claim REVIEW_VERIFIED.

Confirm the persisted IMPLEMENTED_GREEN runId and the lock, and verify the completed visual evidence with oracle-verify.mjs. A certifiable visual PASS must be a schema-v3 artifact produced by a locked test of a trusted oracle-run --adapter node-test run driving Playwright; a standalone Playwright adapter and a Browser MCP observation are not accepted. If the visual evidence is still pending, return IMPLEMENTED_GREEN_PENDING_VISUAL. When it is complete, return RESUME_STANDARD or RESUME_HIGH according to risk to proceed only to the existing review, and do not record the IMPLEMENTED_GREEN transition again. Unresolved policy returns POLICY_GAP with a structured decision and the runId, and records oracle-run.mjs transition --to NEEDS_DECISION. A verification failure is FAIL with the actual error and the runId.
Before the ledger is created, preserve the POLICY_GAP or FAIL classification, the structured decision, and the actual error, and end without creating or guessing a runId.

After init, preserve the POLICY_GAP or FAIL classification, the actual runId, the structured decision, and the actual error, and end. Normalize a nullable decision/error explicitly to null and do not invent a runId.
End a Design-only run as ORACLE_READY.
End a Delivery run as REVIEW_VERIFIED.
End a run the user cancelled without further changes.
